name: What should I look for when choosing a residential general contractor in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a residential general contractor in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a residential general contractor in the Bay Area, look for proper licensing and insurance, a strong portfolio of completed projects relevant to yours, and positive client references. Experience with local building codes and permitting processes in places like Pacifica, Daly City, or San Mateo is crucial. Assess their communication style, transparency regarding costs and timelines, and their ability to problem-solve. A clear contract, good rapport, and a track record of quality workmanship are also important indicators of a reliable contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensing, insurance, relevant portfolio, references, local code experience, clear communication, and a strong contract when choosing a contractor in the Bay Area.
